verdict.rationale: Mangopay's wallet infrastructure explicitly supports splitting funds among unlimited wallets and taking platform fees automatically (docs-5, docs-11, docs-10), which covers routing to multiple sellers and taking a cut as first-class wallet/transfer objects. However, evidence for reversing or adjusting a split after the fact is thin — only refund/dispute/chargeback mechanics are documented (docs-12, docs-13), not adjustable splits or explicit Transfer-object reversal semantics. Missing for 10: detailed API object docs for Transfers/split reversal or adjustment, and independent/hands-on confirmation of multi-party split-and-reverse workflows.
